reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited clauses support it: § 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and independently developed IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor; § 14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further assurances; § 14.3 keeps Vendor Technology with Vendor but routes embedded Vendor Technology into the § 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works; § 14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback non-exclusive with Customer retaining unrestricted rights. This meets the preferred position.

No assignment of Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor and no joint-ownership grant appears anywhere in the cited text, so no walk-away trigger; the deterministic check confirming no residual assignment is consistent.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.

The rationale correctly treats the payment condition on Deliverable ownership and the anonymized-telemetry carve-out from the Customer Data definition as customary minor notes rather than material deviations, per the classification rules (sub-elements short of preferred wording are noted, not flagged).
